children: Canada heavy oil producer's Q3 production rose 6% from prior qtr to 123,486 boe/d
Operating earnings were flat qtr/qtr as higher output offset lower oil prices
Company raised quarterly dividend by 7% to C$0.32 per share
Company expects to provide 2027 guidance after Greenfire Resources acquisition closes in January 2027
HIGHER PRODUCTION - Co said increased Q3 output offset lower oil prices, keeping operating earnings flat qtr/qtr
COLD LAKE PERFORMANCE - Q3 production gains attributed to strong output from D01 West pad at Lindbergh, which delivered record productivity and low steam-oil ratio
FACILITY DOWNTIME - Lloydminster Conventional production was steady as strong performance at Cactus Lake was offset by downtime at other fields
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Strathcona Resources Ltd is C$52.00, about 43.1% above its November 6 closing price of C$36.34
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
